title: Better Explosions Enhanced
description: A very simple modpack that make explosions look and act cooler !
body:
Tired of vanilla boring explosions ? Then you are at the right place ! 
This is a very simple modpack. It adds some mods that greatly improves explosions -----------------

**Features:**

1. Shaky screen when near an explosion
1. Dynamic explosion size that adapt to the explosive
1. Improved cosmetic
1. Flying block debris
1. Lethal Shrapnel (small fragment of metal flying super fast) who breaks fragile blocks
1. Flying blocks
1. You better don't smelt TNT in regular furnace cuz... now you can... maybe.
1. More effects !
1. Structures collapse
   
Works on Vanilla explosions and on most modded/custom ones.

**Informations:**

You need to install the modpack on both serveur & client side to make it work. Some mods are customizable.

For any suggestions or to report bugs, go to my [Discord Serveur](https://discord.gg/JjZfVHQ8Zy). I will update this project sometimes.

The name "Better Explosions Enhanced", Logo and branding are reserved.

**Important !**

All credits goes to actual owners of each mod.

This modpack includes many excellent mods created by talented developers. Please support the original creators on Modrinth and their project pages.
